text:
Aisha Patel: Quick capture from today's Acme kickoff — dropping raw asks and quotes for product triage.
Marco Rivera: thanks Aisha, appreciate the quick sync. can you list top 3 in one line each?
Aisha Patel: 1) Need clearer per-account/per-route cost visibility (surprise invoices). 2) Import flow failing on large embedding payloads (>2k tokens). 3) Request for 'estimated invoice' preview before heavy jobs.
Devon Chen: noted. cost visibility is product-y; import error looks like a backend truncation bug. invoice preview could be a short-term UI hook.
Lena Ortiz: I can repro the import failure with their sample. looks like our preprocessor drops a field and downstream throws a 400. sending repro steps below.
Aisha Patel: repro steps (from call): paste CSV -> click import -> progress bar stalls -> 400. sample log:
```json
{"error":"truncate_failed","file_rows":812,"sample_size":2398}
```
Raj Singh: tagging renewal risk — Acme said they'd reconsider at next billing cycle if cost surprises continue. this is a P2 at-risk account.
Marco Rivera: priority proposal: per-account cost visibility = P1 (reduces churn risk). import reliability = P1 (onboarding blocker). invoice preview = P2 (nice-to-have).
Devon Chen: rough engineering estimate: import fix = 3 days to patch + 1 day QA; cost visibility MVP = 2 sprints (backend + console mock); invoice preview = 1 sprint if we mock numbers.
Lena Ortiz: can ship a console mock for cost view within one week for CS demos. will open a WIP branch and attach screenshots.
Aisha Patel: action items: 1) Marco to file a roadmap ticket and set priority. 2) Devon + Lena to spin up import-fix PR and quick mock. 3) CS to send the customer follow-up email with interim workaround and timeline.
Marco Rivera: I'll create the ticket and link this thread. assigning to @Devon and @Lena.
ops-bot: Reminder set — follow up with Acme in 7 days.
Aisha Patel: thanks team. I'll post the call recording and sample CSV in the shared drive. :thumbsup:
Marco Rivera: thumbs up.
Devon Chen: on it.
Lena Ortiz: will ping once branch is up.
Raj Singh: keeping an eye on renewal. reach out if we need an exec note.
